name: Neutral primary correction (base for every look)
definition: Set black/white points, neutral greys and normal saturation before any look.
how: Levels to pull blacks to ~2% and whites to ~98%; white-balance on a known neutral; then saturation 1.0. Always first in the chain.
purpose: Consistent starting point so looks apply equally across shots.

examples.note: correction (primaries) before memory-colour secondaries and looks

ai_image_prompt: neutral colour balance, natural contrast, no colour grade
ai_video_prompt: neutral colour balance, natural contrast, no heavy colour grade
common_mistakes: applying a LUT before balancing
matching shots by eye on an uncalibrated laptop only
check: Waveform: blacks 0-5%, whites <=100%; vectorscope: greys at centre.

name: Warm daylight
how: Warm white balance by mix, preserve lightness, small gamma lift.
avoid_when: cool product colours that must stay true
ai_image_prompt: warm natural daylight, soft warm white balance, gentle saturation
ai_video_prompt: warm natural daylight colour, gentle saturation, consistent colour throughout
common_mistakes: warming the product too (grade bg layer only when product colour matters)
check: Vectorscope: whites slightly toward orange, skin on the skin line.

name: Golden hour
definition: Warm highlights, slightly cool-neutral shadows, soft contrast.
how: Warm by temperature mix, push highlights orange with colorbalance, mild S-curve.
hyperframes_equivalent: warm-daylight + intensity, or custom adjust temperature>0
ai_image_prompt: golden hour colour, warm orange highlights, soft contrast
ai_video_prompt: golden hour colour palette, warm highlights, soft contrast, consistent across the shot
common_mistakes: grading noon hard top light as golden hour (shadows give it away)
check: Light direction in the image is low/side, otherwise use warm_daylight.

name: Teal-orange (subtle, skin-safe)
definition: Shadows toward teal, highlights toward orange, at low strength.
how: colorbalance shadows -R +B, highlights +R -B, values <= 0.05; vibrance for gentle chroma. Grade background layer only when product/skin colour matters.
purpose: Separate warm subjects from a cool background (colour contrast instead of light contrast).
use_when: warm skin/product against an environment you can cool
avoid_when: blue/teal products or wardrobe (they get swallowed)
scenes whose story colour is not warm/cool

examples.note: rationale: skin sits in orange, so teal shadows separate subject; golden-hour imitation offered only as a guess

ai_image_prompt: subtle teal shadows and warm skin highlights, natural skin tones, restrained grade
ai_video_prompt: restrained teal shadows, warm natural skin highlights, consistent grade
common_mistakes: values > 0.1 turn skin orange and whites cyan
every shot in a series graded identical regardless of scene meaning (look fatigue)
check: Vectorscope: skin cluster still on the skin line; whites near centre.

name: Bleach bypass (emulation)
definition: Desaturated, high-contrast, silvery look emulating skipped bleach in film processing.
ai_image_prompt: bleach bypass look, desaturated colours, high contrast, silvery highlights
ai_video_prompt: desaturated high-contrast bleach bypass look throughout
common_mistakes: crushing faces into black on phones
check: Eyes still readable at phone brightness 50%.

name: Film fade (lifted blacks)
definition: Milky blacks, slightly compressed whites, warm-cool split, reduced saturation.
how: Curve lifts black to 0.08 and caps white at 0.94; small colour split; saturation 0.85.
avoid_when: anything that needs punch on a small screen in daylight
ai_image_prompt: faded film look, lifted milky blacks, soft muted colours
ai_video_prompt: faded film colour, lifted blacks, muted colours throughout
common_mistakes: lifted blacks + platform compression = grey mush

name: High-key clean (clinical commercial)
definition: Bright mids, clean whites, slightly cool-neutral.
how: Lift mids, keep black near 0.04, slight cool temperature mix, saturation 0.95.
ai_image_prompt: bright clean clinical colour, white surfaces, slightly cool neutral tones
ai_video_prompt: bright clean neutral colour, white surfaces stay white, no colour cast
common_mistakes: clipping white products/backgrounds

name: Noir monochrome
definition: Black-and-white with deep blacks, bright highlights and vignette.
use_when: noir parody, flashbacks, night optic noir beats
ai_image_prompt: black and white film noir, deep blacks, high contrast, hard side light
ai_video_prompt: black and white noir look, deep shadows, hard light
common_mistakes: mid-greys everywhere (no true black/white)

name: Day-for-night moonlight
definition: Daylight footage turned into night: darker, desaturated, cool.
how: Brightness down, saturation ~0.55, gamma 0.9, cool temperature mix, compress highlights to 0.8. Requires no bright sky in frame and side/back light in the source.
hyperframes_equivalent: preset night-lift (opposite direction: lifts night footage)
use_when: AI day images re-used for night scenes
avoid_when: bright sky or hard noon shadows in the source
practicals that should glow (they will not)
ai_image_prompt: (generate source) dusk, side light, no sky visible, low contrast
common_mistakes: sky stays bright -> reads as day with a blue filter
check: Add one warm practical/window overlay so night reads.

name: Reels daylight lift (phone-viewing safety)
definition: Mild mid-tone lift and vibrance so dark grades survive bright-room phone viewing.
how: Lift 0.3 and 0.7 points by ~0.04; vibrance +0.15. Apply last, after the look.
purpose: Compensate for viewing a gamma-2.4 dim-room grade in daylight on a phone.
use_when: final pass for 9:16 social deliveries of dark scenes

examples.note: reference EOTF gamma 2.4 measured in a dark room; phone viewing is rarely that

common_mistakes: stacking this on top of film_fade (double lift)
check: Watch the export on a phone outdoors and indoors.

name: Pastel storybook
definition: Low contrast, lifted blacks, gently warm, saturation reduced.
how: Curve lift + saturation 0.82 + mild warm mix.
ai_image_prompt: soft pastel storybook colours, low contrast, gentle warm light
ai_video_prompt: soft pastel storybook colour throughout, low contrast
common_mistakes: no value contrast left for the focal point
check: Focal point still the highest local contrast.

name: Neon night split
definition: Blue-magenta shadows, cyan-ish highlights, punchy contrast and saturation.
how: colorbalance split plus contrast 1.08 and saturation 1.15.
ai_image_prompt: neon night colour grade, magenta and cyan, deep blue shadows
ai_video_prompt: neon night grade, magenta-cyan palette, deep blue shadows throughout
common_mistakes: chroma clipping/banding after platform compression
check: RGB parade no channel pinned at 100%; add grain if banding.

name: Muted editorial
definition: Reduced saturation, slightly firmer contrast, neutral.
use_when: luxury frames, documentary, serious health topics
ai_image_prompt: muted editorial colour, desaturated natural palette, soft contrast
common_mistakes: product colour desaturated too (protect product layer)
check: Product hue matches the real frame photo.

name: Sickly green (horror/illness)
how: colorbalance +G in shadows and mids, -R/-B; saturation 0.7; contrast 1.1; vignette.
use_when: zombie series, horror beats, bad-eye-health warnings
ai_image_prompt: sickly green fluorescent colour cast, desaturated, harsh contrast, dark vignette
ai_video_prompt: sickly green fluorescent grade, harsh contrast throughout
common_mistakes: using green cast accidentally from AI images (fix with neutral_correct)
check: Is the cast motivated (fluorescent tubes, story)?

name: Charcoal on warm paper
definition: Monochrome with warm paper highlights and neutral-cool shadows.
how: Monochrome, warm highlights via colorbalance, lifted black to paper-grey.
purpose: Unify pencil/charcoal story frames (Mint & Tao, Slowly Growing) into one paper look.
ai_image_prompt: charcoal drawing on warm cream paper, monochrome, soft paper texture
common_mistakes: pure grey (digital) instead of paper-warm whites
check: Whites read as paper (slightly warm), not screen white.

name: Memory / flashback
definition: Desaturated, lifted, warm, slightly soft and grainy.
how: Saturation 0.6, lift curve, warm mix, light blur, temporal grain.
ai_image_prompt: soft faded memory, warm desaturated colours, slight blur and film grain
common_mistakes: blur on text overlays (apply to footage layer only)
check: Present-time scenes never use this grade.

name: Cold clinical
definition: Cool white balance, lower saturation, slight contrast.
avoid_when: warm human resolution beats (switch to warm for contrast)
ai_image_prompt: cool clinical colour, bluish whites, muted tones
common_mistakes: cold everywhere so the warm payoff has no contrast
check: Is there a later warm beat that this sets up (contrast/affinity)?

name: Cross-process (emulation)
definition: Shifted channel curves giving yellow-green highlights and blue-magenta shadows.
how: ffmpeg curves preset cross_process at reduced saturation.
ai_image_prompt: cross-processed film look, yellow-green highlights, blue shadows
common_mistakes: preset at full strength looks broken on skin
check: Blend 50% with original if skin breaks (use blend filter or HyperFrames intensity).
